messages:
olivia: Heads up — intermittent GPU health degradation observed in apac-southeast2 pool. Tail latency spikes + a subset of requests getting canceled. Routing shows ~18-22% error rate on some nodes. I opened the pool dashboard and started node evictions.
sam: On it. Running quick checks on node memory & PCIe errors. Can you paste the node IDs?
olivia: node IDs: gcdn-apac-42, gcdn-apac-43, gcdn-apac-57. Errors look like ECC corrections + occasional NVLINK timeouts.
status-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: apac-southeast2 GPU pool health degraded — degraded capacity 20% — auto-eviction triggered. Incident #INC-20260318-APAC.
dinesh: We need a customer-facing blurb + ETA to put on status. Severity? Are we doing automatic failover to other regions?
olivia: Marking SEV3 for now (customer impact, degraded perf). We've started shifting non-pinned traffic to us-west1 and eu-west1 via smart-routing. Latency penalty ~50-120ms for re-routed customers.
nana: (typo) — sorry, meant ana.
nana: Sorry, just saw — who is coordinating support comms? I can help draft the status update.
nana: Draft for status: "We're investigating elevated error rates and degraded latency in apac-southeast2 GPU pool. Traffic is being routed to alternate regions automatically; some customers may see increased latency. We're replacing unhealthy nodes and expect improved stability within ~30-45 minutes. Follow updates here." Thoughts?
kevin: Can we offer customers a knob to pin to other regions for lower latency while we recover? Also check that Dedicated customers with region pinning are not impacted.
olivia: Good call. Pinned Dedicated workloads remain on their reserved capacity — we will not migrate those. That said, some customers on shared hosted API saw automatic reroutes.
sam: Quick dump from one affected node:
``` 
$ sudo dmesg | tail -n 30
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 12345.679012] nvidia-smi: GPU 0: ECC errors increasing
```
Planning to cordon and reboot gcdn-apac-43 now.
eve: Can we push a status page update + targeted email to customers with active jobs in APAC? Support can open priority tickets for anyone reporting degraded latency. Dinesh, want to lead comms?
dinesh: I’ll own it. Drafting targeted message: "We're aware of degraded performance in apac-southeast2 and are routing traffic to alternate regions. If you see errors, please reply to this thread or open a priority support ticket referencing INC-20260318-APAC. Estimated recovery: 30-45 minutes. We will notify when the pool returns to normal." I'll also add guidance for switching regions via the SDK: 
```
client = RedwoodClient(region='us-west1')
resp = client.generate(...)
```
Anyone else want edits?
olivia: Add note about pinned workloads staying in place. Also include help link to region migration doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/region-failover (placeholder).
anA: (fixing name) — fine with draft. Also please mention: we will not roll back model versions.
kevin: Cost note: cross-region routing raises egress and compute costs. We should flag for finance if this persists >24h.
status-bot: Update: Auto-eviction completed for 3 nodes; re-routing continues. Health now at 92% capacity.
olivia: Replacements in progress; monitoring metrics (queue length, 95p latency). Next ETA check in 10m.
dinesh: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260318-APAC (placeholder). Sending targeted emails now.
eve: Support tickets created for 12 customers so far, triaging. Will escalate to SEV2 if we see failing SLAs.
sam: Reboot completed on gcdn-apac-43; telemetry shows reduced ECC errors. Running longer burn test.
olivia: Thanks team. Keep updates short in this thread. If anything degrades further, escalate to SEV2.
note: This thread contains the root message and replies about an APAC GPU pool degradation, actions taken, and customer communication drafts.
